alternatives.proposal: Construct the Linux argv token using a dedicated PurePosixPath or posixpath.join, independent of the launcher host; keep concrete native Path for actual filesystem I/O.
alternatives.advantage: Makes destination path syntax explicit on both hosts.
alternatives.caution: Do not blindly replace global LINUX with a PurePosixPath if BASE on Linux depends on filesystem methods; separate argv representation from I/O Path. No .resolve from Windows for Linux destination.
alternatives.preference: Recommended conceptually; not implemented or adopted.

alternatives.proposal: Keep existing host Path and serialize the Linux script token explicitly via (LINUX/script).as_posix().
alternatives.advantage: Smaller local source delta for the present fixed /mnt/c literal.
alternatives.caution: Still relies on host parsing before serialization; constrain to the exact fixed POSIX-rooted destination, no drive/UNC/generalized user input. Changes need a new contract/identity and decision.
